Five Drown During Ganesh Immersion in MP; Aid Announced

Five people drowned during Ganesh idol immersion ceremonies in Madhya Pradesh's Khandwa and Dhar districts. Chief Minister Mohan Yadav announced financial aid of ₹4 lakh for each of the deceased's families. In Hyderabad, the immersion procession for the 69-foot Khairatabad Bada Ganesh began after a three-hour delay, with police stating the event passed peacefully.
